articles.headline: How Iowa ended up with Van Hayden, college football's most unique cover band
articles.description: A group of Hawkeyes fans decided to learn Van Halen covers as a bit. Now they're the life of the party on game days.

images.name: Van Hayden - LEDE [1296x729]
images.caption: Monday through Friday, they fill prescriptions, write code, consult on health plans and restore historic homes. On Saturdays in Iowa City, they put on white pants, aviators and fake mustaches, climb into a retired ambulance and become Van Hayden.

images.name: 01 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x4043]
images.caption: Legendary Iowa coach Hayden Fry wanted the Hawkeyes to look good, and rock gods Van Halen packed arenas. The spirit of both '80s icons combine at Van Hayden's tailgate concerts.
images.credit: AP Photo/Reed Saxon, Mary Beth Koeth for ESPN, Fin Costello/Redferns

images.name: 02 - Van Hayden Inline [8031x5357]
images.caption: Andy Olson (Eddie Van Hayden), Jake Olson (Alex Van Hayden), 15-year-old Masen Funk (The Pasadena Kid) and Brent Buresh (Michael Van Hayden) lay down the grooves while Robby Marvin, front, gets the crowd going as Hayden Lee Roth.

images.name: 03 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x2674]
images.caption: Four-year-old Sofia Thieleane Raecker, with her grandfather Steve Raecker, planned ahead and brought her own guitar to the family tailgate at the Dental Science Building in anticipation of Van Hayden's appearance before the Ohio State game.

images.name: 04 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x4043]
images.caption: Van Hayden makes several tailgate stops a day in multiple lots, including for a gathering of Fry's former players (top). The band has its own devotees, including Brandon Snell (middle), who wore a Van Hayden shirt and Zubaz pants to see them play.

article.story: South Alabama (3-2) at Arkansas State (2-3), Oct. 8 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Arkansas State by 1.5. Against the spread: Arkansas State 2-3, South Alabama 3-2. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Arkansas State Offense Overall: 348.4 yards per game (105th in FBS) Passing: 208.6 yards per game (91st) Rushing: 139.8 yards per game (95th) Scoring: 24.0 points per game (98th) Arkansas State Defense Overall: 399.6 yards per game (110th in FBS) Passing: 203.4 yards per game (63rd) Rushing: 196.2 yards per game (128th) Scoring: 23.4 points per game (70th) South Alabama Offense Overall: 451.0 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 245.8 yards per game (54th) Rushing: 205.2 yards per game (32nd) Scoring: 35.4 points per game (42nd) South Alabama Defense Overall: 411.6 yards per game (120th in FBS) Passing: 234.2 yards per game (106th) Rushing: 177.4 yards per game (113th) Scoring: 31.6 points per game (120th) Arkansas State ranks 133rd in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 50.8% of the time. South Alabama ranks 38th on offense, converting on 46.1% of third downs. South Alabama ranks 14th in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Arkansas State is 10th in the FBS averaging 35.4 penalty yards per game. Arkansas State is 123rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 93.3% of trips. South Alabama's red zone offense ranks 72nd, scoring on 85.7% of red zone opportunities. Arkansas State ranks 87th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:19, compared to South Alabama's 10th-ranked average of 33:56. Team leaders Arkansas State Passing: Trey Owens, 1,043 yards, 5 TDs, 4 INTs, 66.9 completion percentage Rushing: Solomon Baggett, 211 yards on 42 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Hunter Summers, 263 yards on 20 catches, 1 TD South Alabama Passing: Jared Hollins, 779 yards, 6 TDs, 2 INTs, 61.0 completion percentage Rushing: P.J. Martin, 328 yards on 76 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Brendan Jenkins, 319 yards on 20 catches, 3 TDs Last game Arkansas State fell to Louisiana 23-20 on Oct. 3. Owens led Arkansas State with 206 yards on 20-of-31 passing (64.5%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Baggett carried the ball 12 times for 51 yards and scored one touchdown. Chauncy Cobb recorded 65 yards on eight catches. South Alabama beat UL Monroe 52-35 on Oct. 3. Hollins led South Alabama with 321 yards on 14-of-19 passing (73.7%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 24 yards. Trae'von Dunbar carried the ball 12 times for 91 yards and scored one touchdown. Anthony Eager recorded 168 yards on four catches with two touchdowns. Next game Arkansas State plays at Southern Miss on Oct. 17. South Alabama plays at Marshall on Oct. 20.
